name: PM-KISAN
benefit: Rs. 6,000 per year in three installments of Rs. 2,000

documents.name: Land record (khasra/khatauni)
documents.form: Land record extract request form (available at Tehsil office)
steps: Visit the Tehsil/Block office land records section
Submit the land record extract request form with identity proof
Collect the signed/stamped land record extract

documents.name: Bank account passbook copy
documents.form: Bank account opening / passbook request form
steps: Visit your bank branch or nearest CSC centre
Request a passbook copy or bank account opening if you do not have one
Keep a photocopy of the first page of the passbook
